concerns.text: No task is defined to retrieve and validate the IL‑Benchmark dataset required by FR‑001 before any computation tasks (T001‑T004). This missing producer violates the foundational‑tasks‑first principle and creates a consumer‑before‑producer ordering error.

FR‑008 mandates fetching experimental bulk‑property data (or falling back to a static CSV) before correlation work, yet no task exists to perform this data acquisition prior to T008/T009. This is another producer‑before‑consumer violation.

User Story 2 (tasks T006‑T007) depends on outputs from User Story 1 (raw_energies.csv) and therefore cannot be shipped independently. The specification requires each US block to be an independently‑shippable unit; the current ordering makes US 2 non‑independent.
User Story 3 (tasks T008‑T009) similarly depends on the scaling factor and corrected energies produced in US 2, breaking the rule that a US block must be testable end‑to‑end on its own.
